messages:
raj: Ran a 6h cross-region cont-batcher benchmark. Comparing H100 (us-west) vs G5 (eu-central) with different kernel selections and scheduler knobs. High level:
- H100 (us-west): batch_window=8ms, max_batch_tokens=2048, quant=q4_0 => p50 18ms, p95 36ms, p99 42ms, throughput ~1.8k tok/s.
- G5 (eu-central): batch_window=12ms, max_batch_tokens=3072, fp16 => p50 21ms, p95 48ms, p99 85ms, throughput ~2.1k tok/s but much higher jitter.
- Observed fairness tilt: when 3 large tenants + many small, small tenants experienced >200ms tail under sustained 65% cluster load.
Charts: https://redwood-internal/charts/bench/1719204456 (rendered: latency/throughput/tenant-slices)

amy: Nice, did you run the same model artifact/quant across both GPUs?

raj: Same model family (mosaic-13b-derived weights) but two variants: H100 used q4_0 quant + tuned kernels (blocked-attn opt) while G5 used fp16 with default kernel fallback. Eval harness: `./bench/run_contbatch.sh --config configs/contbatch/region_vs_gpu.yaml --duration 6h`

raj: Paste of relevant config snippet:
```yaml
scheduler:
  batch_window_ms: 8        # H100 run
  max_batch_tokens: 2048
  fairshare_decay: 0.5
  tenant_priority: dynamic
kernels:
  prefer: [blocked_attention, fused_gemm]
  fallback: [default_matmul]
quantization:
  model_variant: q4_0
```

tessa: Thanks — did you measure quality regressions after q4_0? Any eval diffs?

raj: Yes, quick eval on 3k prompt set: answer_f1 dropped -0.6 absolute vs fp16 on some slotty QA; overall perplexity +1.2. So q4_0 is fine for latency/cost but watch QA quality.

perf-bot: CI-bench-notify: cont-batcher/1719204456 finished. Duration: 6h. Issues: 2 quality regressions on eval-suite/qa-coherence (-0.8), one scheduling hotspot trace attached.

amy: Do we have kernel selection traces? I want the kernel switch counts per step for G5 — those p99 spikes look like kernel fallback thrash.

raj: Yep — link to trace + flamegraph: https://redwood-internal/traces/1719204456-kernels. Summary: G5 saw many default_matmul falls at sequence lengths >1024 which triggered >10ms spikes per step. H100 used blocked_attention and avoided that.

simon: Proposal: For multi-tenant regional pools, toggle fairshare_decay -> 0.65 and introduce tenant max_batch_tokens cap 512 for best-effort small tenants, keep large tenants 2048. Also try lowering batch_window to 6ms for H100 in us-west to reduce p50 further.

amy: I support trying the decay bump. Can we run 2h smoke with synthetic small-tenant mix (10k qps-ish) before rolling?

raj: I'll schedule a 2h smoke for tomorrow morning (us-west primetime 06:00 UTC). I'll attach the smoke command and expected dashboards.

perf-bot: Scheduled job: cont-bench-smoke/1719250000 by raj for 2024-06-18T06:00:00Z.

tessa: Quick note — if we change quant profile per-region, add eval gating to avoid QA regressions slipping to prod.

simon: Agreed. Add a canary rollout that pins fp16 for QA-sensitive tenants.

amy: :thumbsup:

raj: Thanks everyone — will post smoke results and updated charts in this thread.
